This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the [[Generation III|third generation]] games [[Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen Versions]] for the [[Game Boy Advance]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Game Freak]] and [[Creatures, Inc.]] All names are given in Western order.
